answers.question: When will I get my refund?
answers.answer: Refunds are processed within 7 business days after approval.

answers.question: How long does delivery take?
answers.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3-5 business days.

answers.question: Where can I find my invoice?
answers.answer: Invoices are sent by email after purchase. Customers can also request another invoice copy from support.

answers.question: Do you offer birthday discounts?
answers.answer: I do not know based on the FAQ.
